derivation: from a compound of G2411 (ἱερόν) and the base of G2041 (ἔργον);
def: to be a temple-worker, i.e. officiate as a priest (figuratively)

occurrences.text: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.
